description: Gap (i) attempt: derive β_loop from the framework's tree-term categorical structure. By 2-strand spectral completeness (End_C(A⊗A) R-rank 2 with exactly {e_+, e_-}, em-spectral-completeness), the 1-loop self-energy cannot live in End(A⊗A); it must extend to End(A⊗A⊗A) = H_3(q) via a 3rd-strand matter insertion. This probe computes tr_M on H_3 for the photon braid σ_1^9 (T_{2,9}) plus 5 candidate matter-loop insertions, all derived from canonical Hecke-word constructions (no fit). Checks whether the resulting ratio Δα_EM matches α/(4π); honest verdict if not.

matter_loop_candidates.name: (a) σ_2² (Hecke quadratic on strand 3)
matter_loop_candidates.rationale: Minimal closed loop: strand 3 returns to itself via σ_2².

matter_loop_candidates.name: (b) σ_2·σ_1·σ_2⁻¹ (matter wraps photon)
matter_loop_candidates.rationale: Strand 3 crosses photon strand 1 (σ_2), then unwraps.

matter_loop_candidates.name: (d) σ_2·σ_1^9·σ_2 (matter rung across photon)
matter_loop_candidates.rationale: Matter strand rungs across the entire photon braid.

matter_loop_candidates.name: (e) (σ_1σ_2)³ = Δ_3² (full twist on 3 strands)
matter_loop_candidates.rationale: Central element; full twist on all 3 strands.

data.verdict: REFUTED — best candidate 445.3% off; H_3 matter insertion alone is insufficient
data.structural_argument: By 2-strand spectral completeness (em-spectral-completeness), End_C(A⊗A) has R-rank 2 with exactly {e_+, e_-} — no third scalar channel. Therefore the 1-loop self-energy CANNOT live in End(A⊗A); it must extend to End(A⊗A⊗A) = H_3(q) via a 3rd-strand matter insertion. This forces the candidate space to be H_3-Hecke words involving σ_2 (the matter-strand generator).
